reference_frame.layer_direction: e_z points from lumen toward outer myocardium

surface_mesh_generator.subdivision_rule: Each oriented triangle is split into four by edge midpoints; shared midpoint IDs are keyed by the sorted endpoint IDs; new faces inherit orientation.
surface_mesh_generator.vertex_projection: Normalize each new vertex to the Euclidean unit sphere before superellipsoid mapping.

endocardial.reference_volume_rule: V0 is the exact signed volume of the finalized oriented triangulated surface, not an analytic rounded-box estimate.
endocardial.reference_area_rule: A0_face_type is the exact sum of reference triangle areas for that material face identity.
endocardial.reference_hinge_rule: theta0_edge is the oriented dihedral angle of the finalized reference mesh.

myocardial.reference_volume_rule: V0 is the exact signed volume of the finalized oriented triangulated surface.
myocardial.reference_area_rule: A0_face_type is the exact sum of reference triangle areas for that material face identity.
myocardial.reference_hinge_rule: theta0_edge is the oriented dihedral angle of the finalized reference mesh.

material_face_identity.parametric_face_direction: u_bar is the normalized sum of the three preimage unit-sphere vertex directions of a triangle.
material_face_identity.persistence: Face identity is assigned in the reference mesh and never recomputed from current geometry.

myocardial_anchor_patches.force_distribution: Fixed reference triangle-area weights, including each triangle's one-third barycentric nodal weights, normalized separately within Gamma_minus and Gamma_plus.
myocardial_anchor_patches.identity_hash: Hash sorted face IDs in each anchor patch together with cell ID.

ECM_layer.tetrahedralization: Each structured brick uses a conforming six-tetra Freudenthal split determined by global lexicographic vertex order.
ECM_layer.reference_orientation: Every tetrahedron is reordered once so det(Dm)>0.

myocardial_two_layer_sensitivity.reason: Stage 0 records only the option. Two-layer geometry requires a new case/spec version after primary one-layer inspection.

full_patch_primary.lateral_compliant_support: outward-facing lateral faces of perimeter myocardial cells only

gate_D_sandwich.interpretation: test fixture only; not surrounding myocardium and not reused in the full patch

periodic_sensitivity.x_pairing: Pair corresponding boundary-cell material nodes by cell row and template vertex ID across x=0 and x=3.
periodic_sensitivity.y_pairing: Pair corresponding boundary-cell material nodes by cell column and template vertex ID across y=0 and y=1.8.
periodic_sensitivity.constraint: paired displacement differences equal zero after removing the imposed lattice translation
periodic_sensitivity.mean_translation_gauge: zero mean displacement; numerical only; zero physical power

support_energy_spec.nodal_weight: one third of the reference areas of all owned support faces incident on the node
support_energy_spec.reference_motion: fixed for all registered Stage 2 verification cases

reference_state_registry.cell_A0: exact finalized reference area per material face identity

reference_bundle_seal.mismatch_action: stop before Stage 1 implementation or any response

owner_exclusivity_rules: Each material face has exactly one material face identity.
Each external support face has at most one environment port owner.
A cell-ECM interface face cannot simultaneously own an environment support port.
Blood ports can target only endocardial apical_lumen faces.
The Gate D fixture port exists only in Gate D and is excluded from full-patch interpretation.
